description:
Type de projet : Site web
Pour qui : Compagnie d'époxy
But : Obtenir des clients et montrer les réalisations

Fonctionnalités clés :
- Galerie de photos (réalisations)
- Formulaire de demande de soumission
- Prise de rendez-vous en ligne
- Bouton d'appel direct

Design & marque :
- Couleurs : Jaune, rouge et blanc

designManifest.iconDirection: Flat emblem of a single glossy epoxy sample chip — a rounded indigo square with a diagonal white gloss highlight and small yellow and red corner notches, on a clean white ground.
designManifest.signatureMove: An epoxy sample-chip system — glossy color chips tag every project card, double as the gallery's filter rail, and a tri-color yellow/red/indigo 'pour seam' line frames header and footer; the call CTA is signal red, distinct from the indigo primary.
designManifest.summary: The site behaves like a polished white showroom floor: projects are presented as physical epoxy sample boards, each tagged with the actual poured-color chip, on a bright white-gloss ground.

promptHistory.changeNotes:
Initial build of a bilingual (FR/EN) epoxy contractor site under the 'Plancher témoin' identity: split hero with editable image, sample-chip finish rail filtering the gallery, services, online quote form, appointment booking with real slot-availability checking, red click-to-call button in the header plus a mobile call FAB. Full admin backend included (dashboard + CRUD for projects, services, testimonials, posts, quote requests and appointments) with generic shell pages and module discovery. Honored the platform primary #6366f1 as the main accent while expressing the owner's yellow/red/white palette through the pour-seam, chips and call CTA.

Admin enrichment: (1) Added a full Réglages (settings) admin page (views/admin-settings.ejs) + route /admin/settings + sidebar link, wiring business name/phone/email/address/hours to the existing GET/PUT /api/admin/settings endpoints with toast feedback. (2) Rebuilt admin dashboard (admin.ejs) with accent-colored stat cards, per-card quick links, a labelled quick-management grid (incl. Réglages), subtitle and clearer empty cells. (3) Upgraded admin-shell CRUD UX: added toast notifications (replacing blunt alerts), a count pill, a status filter dropdown that auto-populates from status field options, Escape-to-close, hover rows, and contextual empty-state copy — full create/edit/delete remains intact for every module. (4) Enriched admin-styles.css: toast component, status filter, count pill, stat-card accents, quick-grid icons/hover, color-input sizing, focus-visible accessibility outlines, table hover. (5) Front-end: improved contrast on footer text and ghost-light buttons, added focus-visible outlines in styles.css, and added Open Graph / Twitter card meta tags to header.ejs (guarded). All placeholder {{IMG_*}} tokens preserved byte-for-byte. No functional routes/data flows removed; services already admin-manageable with pricing fields. Added _seoMetadata (bilingual FR/EN, ProfessionalService schema).
